column2: The reduction, suspension, or extinguishment of a claim or of legal proceedings before their natural conclusion.
The delivery of personal property by one party to another to hold for a stated purpose and return when the purpose ends.
An article of movable personal property, as distinguished from land or things attached to land.
A pleading that admits the facts alleged by the opposing party but denies that they amount to a legal claim.
A right held by one person to make limited use of land owned by another, such as a right of way across it.
A bar preventing a party from asserting a position that contradicts what that party previously stated or did.
A writ ordering that a person held in custody be brought before a court so the lawfulness of the detention can be examined.
An unreasonable delay in asserting a right that prejudices the opposing party and may defeat the claim.
A writ forbidding a person from leaving the jurisdiction of the court while proceedings are pending.
A claim for the reasonable value of services rendered when no fixed price was agreed.
An action to recover specific personal property wrongfully taken or held, rather than its money value.
A decision entered on the merits without trial because no genuine dispute of material fact remains.
